description: Ministry of Higher Education - Conditions for PhD (Nanoscience and Nanotechnology) Degree of Sri Lanka Institute of Nanotechnology (pvt) Ltd.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - an order issued under Section 25A of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, amending the schedule to a previous order. It establishes regulatory conditions and qualifications for a degree program at the Sri Lanka Institute of Nanotechnology. While it mentions a minister's name and title, this is incidental to the main purpose of publishing a legal order and regulatory framework for higher education qualifications, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
